policy.purpose: Preserve high-value local sources that are useful editorially but unsafe for automatic admission because of provenance, event-time semantics, structural incompatibility or editorial-safety constraints.

sources.reason: The official APAVIL scheduled-outages page is highly useful for residents and exposes explicit interruption dates and time windows inside notice titles, but those are service-event dates, not necessarily article publication dates. The current zero-LLM freshness gate is publication-date based, so admitting this listing as a normal news source could conflate event time with published_at.
safe_use: manual discovery
direct verification of affected localities and streets
verification of scheduled interruption date and time window
public-service utility research
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic UTILITY_ADVISORY source contract that separates published_at from event_start/event_end, requires explicit geographic scope and primary-source provenance, and may admit only current/future service advisories without converting event dates into publication dates.

sources.reason: The official Drăgășani site exposes a dedicated 2026 register for building/demolition permits, but the underlying evidence is published as periodic register documents rather than ordinary article posts. The existing newsroom freshness gate is article-publication-date based and does not yet distinguish a register document's crawl/publication date from the permit row date inside that document.
safe_use: manual discovery of new construction and demolition permits
primary-source verification of permit number and permit date
verification of beneficiary, declared work and location from the official register
local development and real-estate trend research
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic DOCUMENT_REGISTER source contract for periodic official tables/PDFs: preserve document_period and source_document provenance, extract row_id and row_date deterministically, admit candidates only from row-level dates, and never treat fetch/listing dates as the event or publication date.

sources.reason: The official club site embeds a live Facebook feed with high-value local sports updates across multiple disciplines, but the website renders relative timestamps such as '1 day ago' and '2 days ago' rather than a stable article-level published_at. The feed is not a normal article archive, so converting those relative labels into publication dates would make freshness depend on crawl time and could misdate posts.
safe_use: manual discovery of CS Vâlcea 1924 results, schedules and athlete updates
direct verification against the official club site and linked federation sources
manual use of official photographs only when the original post and provenance are preserved
sports-source monitoring without automatic publication
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic SOCIAL_EMBED source contract that resolves the canonical platform post URL or post ID and absolute platform timestamp, preserves account provenance, rejects crawl-relative time labels as published_at, and keeps social claims fail-closed until independently corroborated when material.

sources.reason: The official AJF Vâlcea portal is a high-value primary source for county football and exposes stable article pages with explicit publication dates. However, the same official Comunicate AJF stream mixes ordinary competition schedules, results and organizational decisions with obituary or memorial notices. Because the current automatic scope can republish title + date + source and category-level URL filtering cannot prove that every item is routine sports news, admitting the whole feed would create avoidable relevance and sensitivity risk. The source is therefore monitored but remains fail-closed until item-level source-safety filtering exists.
safe_use: manual discovery of Liga IV, Liga V, Liga VI, Cupa României, youth and local-football schedules and results
primary-source verification of article publication time and competition dates
cross-checking match schedules and competition decisions against official AJF competition pages
manual publication only after excluding obituary, disciplinary and other sensitive or reputational items
sources.core_feedback: This reinforces the existing generic SOURCE_SAFETY / REPUTATIONAL_RISK requirement with a mixed-feed case: safe sports updates and sensitive items can coexist under one official category. CORE should support fail-closed item-level safety classification or explicit allowlisted content classes before automatic projection; a source tier or category URL alone is insufficient. No Vâlcea-specific classifier should be added.

sources.reason: The official IPJ Vâlcea feed is structurally compatible with article discovery and has trustworthy article-level dates, but many headlines themselves assert detention, investigation, suspected criminal conduct, sanctions or other reputationally sensitive facts about people before final adjudication. Because the current automatic scope can publish the source headline verbatim as title + date + source, date provenance alone is insufficient: automatic admission could republish allegations without the contextual safeguards, presumption-of-innocence language, corroboration and editorial review required by VÂLCEA CLAR. The feed is therefore removed from automatic publication while remaining a primary source for manual verification.
safe_use: manual discovery of police and public-safety developments
primary-source verification of dates, procedural status and official police statements
cross-checking road-safety and prevention campaigns that do not identify or accuse private persons
manual reporting only after reputational-sensitivity review and preservation of presumption-of-innocence context
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic SOURCE_SAFETY / REPUTATIONAL_RISK gate that is independent of date provenance and source tier. Source classes such as police, prosecutors, courts and disciplinary bodies must not become automatically publishable merely because their article dates and titles are structurally valid. The gate should classify or require explicit review for allegation, detention, investigation, sanction and accusation semantics in headlines/body, preserve procedural status and presumption-of-innocence context, and fail closed before public projection. This belongs in CORE; Vâlcea should keep only the local source classification.

sources.reason: The official CJ Vâlcea procurement page exposes high-value row-level evidence — notice identifier, notice date, procurement description and linked files — but it is an HTML register rather than an article feed. The current automatic news adapter is publication-date/article oriented and must not invent published_at from a row date or collapse generic 'Vizualizare' links into headlines. The source is therefore preserved for monitoring and verification but excluded from automatic publication.
safe_use: manual discovery of county procurement notices
primary-source verification of notice identifier and notice date
verification of procurement description, deadline and attached procurement documents
public-money and infrastructure research
cross-checking later award or contract reporting against the original notice
sources.core_feedback: This confirms the existing generic DOCUMENT_REGISTER requirement with an HTML-table variant: LOCAL NEWS OS should extract row_id, row_date, row_description and canonical evidence links deterministically, keep row_date distinct from published_at, preserve source-table provenance, and admit nothing automatically when a stable row identity or date cannot be proven.

sources.reason: The official Drăgășani announcement listing is a JavaScript-rendered catalogue and its server-rendered HTML does not expose the article links needed by the current HTML-only automatic discovery adapter. Individual official announcement pages do expose a stable title and an explicit 'Adaugat la data' publication date, so the source is editorially strong but must remain fail-closed until article enumeration can be resolved without inventing URLs or relying on search-engine indexes as the canonical listing.
safe_use: manual discovery of municipal announcements
direct verification on the individual official announcement page
verification of the explicit article-level 'Adaugat la data' publication date
administration, local taxes, public services and municipal-decision research
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic DYNAMIC_LISTING source contract for official JavaScript-rendered catalogues: resolve stable item URLs through a deterministic browser/API/embedded-data adapter, preserve the official listing as discovery provenance, require article-level date provenance before admission, and reject search-engine result pages as publication evidence.

sources.publisher: Oficiul de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară Vâlcea
sources.reason: The official OCPI Vâlcea announcements page is editorially valuable for cadastral and property-registration developments, but notices are presented inline on the listing rather than as a reliable stream of individually dated article pages. The current automatic news adapter is article-link based; additionally, the live newsroom runner recorded a DNS resolution failure for this host while independent web verification still reached the official page. Keeping it in automatic discovery would therefore mix a structural incompatibility with transient network-health noise and cannot improve fail-closed freshness admission.
safe_use: manual discovery of OCPI Vâlcea cadastral and property-registration announcements
primary-source verification of notice text and explicit inline notice date
verification of PNCCF financing and cadastral-registration developments
real-estate and land-registry research without automatic publication
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS should distinguish ARTICLE_FEED from LISTING_ONLY source contracts before source admission. LISTING_ONLY sources need stable item identity plus scoped inline-date provenance, and network-health state must remain separate from structural eligibility so a transient DNS failure cannot be mistaken for an editorial-format failure.

sources.reason: The official Termoficare Vâlcea feed publishes individually dated posts with stable article pages and high-value service interruption details, but its article title/H1 is generically 'ANUNT'. The current automatic contract intentionally publishes only title + publication date + source and requires a meaningful title, so admitting this feed would either drop the item or expose a useless headline. The body also carries the actual service-event window and affected-area details, which must not be conflated with published_at or copied into a synthetic headline without a structured utility-advisory contract.
safe_use: manual discovery of district-heating and hot-water interruptions
primary-source verification of publication date and service-event window
verification of affected streets, thermal points and public institutions
public-service utility research and cross-checking against CET Govora notices
sources.core_feedback: This strengthens the existing generic UTILITY_ADVISORY requirement: support published_at separately from event_start/event_end and affected_area, preserve canonical article provenance, and allow only deterministic advisory labels derived from verified structured fields when the publisher uses a generic headline. Do not generate free-form headlines from body text and do not build a Vâlcea-specific parser.

sources.publisher: Institutul Național de Hidrologie și Gospodărire a Apelor (INHGA)
sources.reason: The official INHGA warning archive publishes individually dated hydrological warnings and attentions with high public-safety value, including notices explicitly addressed to SGA Vâlcea and affecting Lotru or Olt sectors in Vâlcea. However, the headline is generic and does not prove Vâlcea relevance: affected geography, severity and the warning validity interval are encoded in the article body. The current title + publication date + source-only automatic contract therefore cannot safely localize the alert or distinguish publication/issue time from the phenomenon validity window, so automatic publication remains disabled.
safe_use: manual discovery of hydrological warnings explicitly mentioning Vâlcea, Lotru or Olt sectors in the county
primary-source verification of warning or attention number and issue time
verification of affected basins, rivers, severity and validity interval from the official warning body
cross-checking local emergency, transport and infrastructure reporting without automatic publication
sources.core_feedback: LOCAL NEWS OS needs a generic GEO_SCOPED_ALERT / STRUCTURED_ALERT contract: deterministically extract affected geography plus issued_at, valid_from, valid_to and severity from primary-source alert bodies; match that geography against the instance before admission; preserve canonical alert provenance; never synthesize a free-form headline; and reject the alert fail-closed when geography, severity or validity is ambiguous. This belongs in CORE, not in a Vâlcea-specific parser.
